description: This file defines a Spring MVC Controller class 'GroupsController' responsible for managing user groups within the admin interface of a web application. It includes methods for displaying, listing, and paging through groups, and manages dependencies such as services for groups, permissions, countries, and localization labels.

classes.name: GroupsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing user groups in the admin panel, providing endpoints for viewing individual groups, listing all groups, and paginating through groups.

methods.name: displayGroup
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to display details of a specific user group specified by ID.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to display a list of all user groups of type ADMIN.

methods.name: pageGroups
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests for paginating through the list of user groups, returning JSON data.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set up menu-related model attributes for the view.
